buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const apiUrl=process.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL||''; if(apiUrl) { const cfg='window.__API_BASE_URL=\''+apiUrl+'\';'; fs.writeFileSync('frontend/config.js', cfg); }"

VITE_API_BASE_URL.description: Backend API base URL (e.g., https://memorai-api.onrender.com/api/v1). Required for production multi-domain deployment.
